query: '
WITH diagnostico_principal AS (
    SELECT
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        diagnosis_description,
        severity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY admission_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
)
SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,
    diag.diagnostico_key,
    fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    CASE
        WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date)
    END AS dias_estancia,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON dep.nombre_departamento = a.department
INNER JOIN diagnostico_principal dp
    ON dp.admission_id = a.admission_id
    AND dp.rn = 1
INNER JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico diag
    ON diag.codigo_icd = dp.icd_code
    AND ISNULL(diag.descripcion_patologia, '') =
        ISNULL(dp.diagnosis_description, '')
    AND diag.nivel_severidad = dp.severity
INNER JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi
    ON fi.fecha_completa = a.admission_date
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa
    ON fa.fecha_completa = a.discharge_date
',
